summary.text: Bob McDermott is the Republican candidate for Hawaii State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Mark Owens; he defeated incumbent Kurt Fevella and Rida Cabanilla in the August 8, 2026 Republican primary.
A former state representative, he served in the Hawaii House from 2012 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: McDermott served in the U.S. Marine Corps and earned an M.B.A. from Chaminade University.
His career experience includes working as a realtor and as a nonprofit executive director.
McDermott served on a Neighborhood Board from 1992 to 1994 and in the Hawaii House of Representatives from 1996 to 2002.
He returned to the House in November 2012 representing District 40 and left office in November 2022 without seeking re-election to that seat.
His committee assignments in 2021-2022 included Water and Land, Finance and Housing.
He was the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in 2024, when incumbent Mazie Hirono defeated him in the general election.
